Movement — leaf litter that wasn't leaves — a whir of wings from under your feet.
Nothing left to take here today.
Travel 2 tiles to Haven.
While you were gone — one thing you missed:
🩸 The Big Loud mauled Ilse (-79 health) over 7 rounds. They're lucky to be breathing. — staying out of sight for the rest of the day — too hurt to meet it again
The pantry is bursting past tomorrow — most of the haul stays in your pack. The fire can wait; the road can't.
You keep a day's food (5950 kcal) and unload 13650 kcal into Haven's pantry.
You walk back into Haven. 19 Codex entries. The village is glad to see you.
You sow Mayapple: 180 days to first harvest. Later harvests need 45 days of regrowth. Tend daily; garden magic can accelerate growth. (2 units sown.)
Donated Mayapple (+3360 kcal). Trust +7. They'll remember this.
A mother from Thornfield pressed a carved token into your hand: "for the winter you fed us." You didn't know there was a winter you'd fed.
You clear a dead bed. Sow fresh seed to start a new crop. (40 kcal.)
You sow Mayapple: 180 days to first harvest. Later harvests need 45 days of regrowth. Tend daily; garden magic can accelerate growth. (2 units sown.)
You coax 3 growing beds forward by 12 days. The next harvest carries the growth magic.
(−200 kcal — food becomes green thumb.)
📋 Hank — 🎣 Fish. Hank nods eagerly. They'll report back by next part.
📋 Ezra — 🍲 Cook. Ezra nods eagerly. They'll report back by next part.
Walking 5 squares (10 kcal)…
You step into the Haven hall.
You push through the doors into open air. Haven grounds — tents, a fire pit, worn paths. The world is that way.
⚠️ They're still here. Waiting.
The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.
⚔ OLD STARE! You're on your own.
Turn-based now. Tap a tile to move — speed is squares. Then act.
The Old Stare thrashes its antlers at you — getting close has a price.
Armor absorbs 5.
Old Stare's antlers hits you for 8.
It BELLOWS — wrong, too deep, like a foghorn heard through water. The sound sits in your teeth.
📋 Hank — 🎣 Fish. Hank nods eagerly. They'll report back by next part.
📋 Ezra — 🍲 Cook. Ezra nods eagerly. They'll report back by next part.
Taken: Sinew cord x2, Gravity hook x1.
The body is stripped. What's left isn't worth taking.
✨ Ability gained: Pocket Sand (L1). Throw sand in eyes. Blinds for 2 rounds. (You always have sand. Don't ask where.)
"SAND! In the eyes! It's in YOUR pocket! How?! We don't know! But it's there!"
"Earned, not given. You did the work — we just wrote it down."
